presets.label: Window blinds
presets.use_when: breaks the beam into horizontal slat shadows, like light through venetian blinds

presets.label: Wide blinds
presets.use_when: a few thick horizontal slats; bold, graphic blind shadows

presets.label: Angled blinds
presets.use_when: diagonal slat shadows, like late sun raking through blinds

presets.label: Vertical blinds
presets.use_when: vertical slat shadows, like vertical blinds or louvres

presets.label: Window panes
presets.use_when: projects a four-pane window frame, like sunlight through a window

presets.label: Window grid
presets.use_when: a nine-pane window (3 by 3 mullions)

presets.label: Arched window
presets.use_when: a tall arched window with mullions; churches, old houses

presets.label: Leaded diamonds
presets.use_when: a leaded diamond-lattice window; period or storybook interiors

presets.label: Leaf breakup
presets.use_when: dappled, broken-up light, like light through foliage; breaks up a flat wash

presets.label: Dense canopy
presets.use_when: mostly shadow with small bright dapples, like a thick tree canopy

presets.label: Sparse leaves
presets.use_when: mostly light with a few leaf shadows; gentle outdoor breakup

presets.label: Bare branches
presets.use_when: thin branch and twig shadows, like winter trees

presets.label: Soft breakup
presets.use_when: low-contrast cloudy breakup that just takes the flatness off a wash

presets.label: Water caustics
presets.use_when: a bright web of caustic lines, like light reflected off a pool

presets.label: Soft iris
presets.use_when: a soft round pool tighter than the cone; a snoot-like cut with a feathered edge

presets.label: Hard iris
presets.use_when: a small, hard-edged round pool; a pin spot

presets.label: Ring
presets.use_when: a ring of light with a dark centre; a halo

presets.label: Slot (barn doors)
presets.use_when: cuts the beam top and bottom into a horizontal band, like closing barn doors

presets.label: Door slit
presets.use_when: a narrow vertical band, like light through a door left ajar

presets.label: Corner cut
presets.use_when: cuts the beam off two sides and a corner, like angled barn doors

presets.label: Dot grid
presets.use_when: a regular grid of dots; graphic, stagey

presets.label: Stars
presets.use_when: scattered pinpoints of light, like a star cloth

presets.label: Bars
presets.use_when: thin vertical bars, like a cell or railings

presets.label: Chain-link fence
presets.use_when: a diamond chain-link fence shadow

presets.label: Narrow spot profile
presets.use_when: a hot centre with fast falloff inside the cone (about 20 degree beam)

presets.label: Medium soft profile
presets.use_when: an even beam with a gentle shoulder (about 45 degrees)

presets.label: Wide flood profile
presets.use_when: broad flood whose brightness rolls off gently toward the edge of a wide cone (about 90 degree field)
